text:
A maara ya n’aka ndị NFL dị ka GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium ma gbanwee aha ya bụ "Kansas City Stadium" maka 2026 FIFA World Cup, ebe a malitere ya site na mgbawa ala na 11 July 1968. O mepere na 12 August 1972, mgbe Kansas City Chiefs meriri St. Louis Cardinals 24–14 n’egwuregwu preseason mbụ. Ewubere ama egwuregwu ahụ dị ka akụkụ nke Truman Sports Complex, nke ọ na-ekerịta ya na Kauffman Stadium, ụlọ MLB’s Royals.

Ndị ụlọ ọrụ Kansas City bụ Kivett and Myers mere atụmatụ mbụ ya; mgbe e mechara nrụzigharị n’agbata 2007 na 2010, ndị Populous, bụbu HOK Sport, mere ya na ihe ruru US$375 nde. Ama egwuregwu ahụ mepere na ikike mmadụ 78,097, nke ejirila site na 1972 ruo 1994, ebe ikike ndị Chiefs nọ ugbu a bụ 76,416 site na 2010 gaa n’ihu.

Ebe a bụ ụlọ ndị Chiefs kemgbe 1972, na-eme ya otu n’ime ama egwuregwu kacha ochie na egwuregwu ọkachamara America. Site na 1996 ruo 2007 ọ nabatara klọb MLS nke a na-akpọbu Kansas City Wiz na Wizards, nke ghọrọ Sporting Kansas City. Ala egwuregwu ya bụ NorthBridge Bermudagrass nke eji kemgbe 2013.

Na March 2021, e rere ikike aha ya na GEHA, na-eme ka aha ya bụrụ GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium. Ama egwuregwu ahụ nwere Guinness World Record maka mkpu ndị mmadụ kacha ụda na ama egwuregwu, 142.2 dBA, nke e mere na 29 September 2014.

Maka 2026 FIFA World Cup, ebe a ga-anabata egwuregwu isii: egwuregwu anọ nke otu, otu egwuregwu Round of 32, na otu nkeji iri na ise.
